page.overview:
Who is Jayden Rundall?

Jayden Rundall is a major character in War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius and the king of Rundall. Known as the Unwavering Gun God, he is largely an unseen figure for most of season one, although his actions and that of his kingdom would still drive a significant part of the plot. He plays a larger role in the game's War of the Gale Highlands season, serving as one of the forces standing against Mont Leonis in his struggle to unify the nations of Ardra.

Jayden is a poli-faceted and complex individual. Thought by many to be a calculating schemer, skilled strategist and an ambitious regent, Jayden also shows an affable, and cordial nature even to his subordinates, which makes him hard to read. Jayden is at heart a thrill seeker and is always ready to jump into action, with the heating war causing him to easily get excited, almost to childish levels in which he even demands to be allowed to participate, with his own generals having to restrain him. In fact the prospect of entertaining himself is one of the central reasons why he is willing to wage war. Nonetheless, he's also shown to be rather airheaded as he easily forgot about his wedding ceremony purely due to all the warring spectacle that lay before him.

His relationship with others, particularly the Heindler royals is rather complicated. While he actively looks out for Oberon Heindler as a brotherly figure, due to their common harsh past as Lykeros prisoners and even preventing him from commiting suicide, Oberon in turn views Jayden as a messianic figure idolizing him to obsessive degrees. As Jayden has Oberon lead the assault against Ovis, effectively against his own fiancee Lucielle Ovis for her ring, it has created the perception that Jayden is taking advantage and manipulating Oberon for personal gain.

Alaya Rundall, Oberon's younger sister and Jayden's fiancee vehemently despises him and plots to have Jayden assassinated as a matter of national pride, and feeling disgust towards Jayden's actions and perceived scheming from his part, despite the fact they are childhood friends. Jayden seems to be openly in love with Alaya and is oblivious to her scorn, but also made aware of the unsavory rumors regarding the wedding which is believed to be a mere political ploy from Jayden in order to have Alaya as a "hostage" allowing him to coerce Heindler, something he denies to his own men.
